content.text: I've used all the XRD scans and four of the five EQE scans. The Fe-rich compositions with mixed phases look best, so I'm spending the last EQE scan between the two best points.

input.rationale: EQE falls off toward Sb-rich (0.0017% at Sb 0.51, 0.0037% at 0.72). The Fe-rich side is best: 0.0091% at 0.17, 0.0098% at 0.26. Aside from Pt substrate peaks, XRD shows hematite plus rutile FeSbO4 at Sb 0.21–0.26. There is only a hematite-like peak at 0.17 and only rutile at 0.31 and above. The flat EQE between 0.17 and 0.26 pointed to a maximum between them, so I measured index 4 (Sb 0.233). It gave the highest EQE, 0.0125%.

content.text:
I submitted **index 4 (Sb fraction 0.233)** as the best composition. At 0.0125% EQE it was the highest of the five compositions I measured. All five EQE and five XRD measurements are used up.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) | Phases seen in XRD (Pt substrate peaks excluded) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.171 | 0.0091 | Mostly one iron-oxide peak, probably hematite |
| **4** | **0.233** | **0.0125** | Not scanned; its neighbours at 0.209 and 0.260 show hematite plus rutile FeSbO₄ |
| 5 | 0.260 | 0.0098 | Hematite plus rutile |
| 12 | 0.506 | 0.0017 | Not scanned |
| 20 | 0.719 | 0.0037 | Not scanned |

- **Fe-rich side wins:** EQE drops sharply once the Sb fraction goes above about 0.3.
- **Why I picked index 4:** EQE was nearly the same at Sb 0.17 and 0.26, so the maximum probably lay between them. I spent the last EQE measurement on index 4, and it came out highest.
- **What the XRD suggests:** Hematite is present with rutile FeSbO₄ from Sb 0.21 to 0.26. Only rutile appears from Sb 0.31 up (scanned at 0.31 and 0.38). The best EQE sits in that mixed-phase band, but that link is inferred and wasn't tested.

**Uncertain:**
- The phase labels are my reading of peak positions against standard patterns.
- The peak could lie at an unmeasured neighbour such as index 3 (0.209) or 6 (0.286), though I only get credit for compositions I measured.
- EQE is low everywhere on the line, at about 0.01% at best.
